sourceReceipts.finding: The current operator page identifies Belize Postal Service but publishes no postcode requirement, assignment denominator, postal geometry or dataset licence.
Current regular-mail instructions require a clearly printed destination address and lodging at a Belize postal office. They contain no postcode requirement, lookup key or area assignment.
The current page describes a private P.O. Box and says its box number forms part of the address. The number is a typed non-area mailing object, not a postcode or area key; no holder row was queried.
UPU copyright and database conditions remain applicable and do not grant bulk assignment or geometry rights.
Website information may be used subject to terms and acknowledgement; that reference permission is not a resource-specific assignment or geometry dataset licence.
The official address example has street, locality and country lines but no postcode. It is format evidence only, not an assignment or geometry release.
The September 2025 Universal DataBase table explicitly lists Belize among countries not requiring postal codes. It grants no assignment, geometry or AGID redistribution right.

blockers: Current UPU evidence explicitly lists Belize among countries not requiring postal codes, the Belize addressing example has no postcode line and current Belize Postal Service instructions publish no postcode requirement.
No current complete finite assignment, alias, validity, correction, exception and typed non-area denominator exists.
No resource-specific open assignment or geometry dataset licence establishes AGID processing, derivation, redistribution and public-serving rights.

No official, derived or virtual rights-cleared BZ postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact exists. District, caye, city, town, village, locality, office, route, address, building, parcel, Point, buffer, cell, model and AGID surfaces are prohibited proxies.
P.O. Box, route, organization, office, Point and other non-area objects cannot be expanded into invented surfaces.
unblockCondition: A competent Belize authority must put postcodes into force and publish a current complete finite assignment/alias/validity/correction/exception/non-area denominator under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Obtain or reproducibly produce only rights-cleared real valid postcode-specific Polygon/MultiPolygon artifacts, publish an approved immutable artifact and pass real BZ normalization, loader, API, no-code/non-area, ambiguity, geometry, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, failure, clear and re-search verification.
